universe._cap_class: small-mid, widened 2026-07-24 per real backtest evidence (see bankroll.py UNIVERSE_MAX_PRICE_TIERS). min_price here is what actually filters live discovery; max_price here only drives scripts/universe_scan.py's manual CLI tool — live discovery (discovery_scan.py/discovery_urgency_check.py) uses bankroll.universe_max_price_for_ceiling() instead, which is the real source of truth for max_price

risk._trailing_stop_source: ratchets up from peak price since entry, mechanically enforced in scripts/guardrails.py check-stops, not LLM-judgment
risk._duplicate_order_source: cooldown blocks a same-ticker/same-action repeat submission without blocking legitimate cross-tick re-entries
risk._drawdown_source: competition mode's circuit breaker, measured from peak equity (state/peak_equity.json), not starting capital. Blocks new BUYs only — SELLs (including stop-losses) always pass. drawdown_halt_pct is a harder stop than pause but same BUY-only scope; see gate_drawdown_circuit_breaker.
risk._stop_patience_source: 2026-07-27: stop_loss_pct/trailing_stop_pct are day-zero distances now, widening toward stop_loss_pct_max/trailing_stop_pct_max the longer a position is held (stop_patience.py), compressing back to base inside the endgame window before bankroll.COMPETITION_END. See scripts/executor.py check_stops().
risk._conviction_floor_source: 2026-07-27: conviction_floor is the grace-period value; it drops toward conviction_floor_min (never below) the longer the account sits under-deployed. See deployment_pressure.py / scripts/executor.py gate_conviction().

discovery_urgency._source: scripts/discovery_urgency_check.py — cash_threshold_pct+min_candidates gate the cash-thin/thin-pipeline AND trigger (checked by the 45-min stonks-discovery-urgent cron); empty_floor is the cash-independent OR trigger, checked every tick via tick_prompt.md step 7 when the Candidates section looks empty

guardrail_gates._note: flip any gate to false to disable it without touching code. scripts/executor.py reads this every run. Per-gate rationale lives in git history (git log -p params.json), not here.
